info.title: agent-fs API
info.description: A persistent, searchable filesystem for AI agents. agent-fs is to files what agentmail is to email.

maxUploadBytes.description: Maximum raw upload size in bytes

features.description: Optional capabilities this server supports (e.g. "share-links"). Absent on older servers.

get.description: Unauthenticated HTML preview of a file shared with the share-create op, with a Download button. The token is the only credential. Expired, revoked and used-up links return the same 'link expired' page (404 for an unknown token, 410 otherwise). Each successful page view counts against maxViews.

302.description: The share is a folder (kind "site"): redirect to /site/{token}/

404.description: Unknown token or file no longer available

410.description: Link expired, revoked or used up

429.description: Too many requests from this address

get.summary: Inline bytes for a share embed
get.description: Serves (or redirects to a short-lived presigned URL for) the shared file inline. Only images, PDF, audio, video and HTML; SVG is never served inline. An HTML page is always proxied (never presigned), at most 25 MB, with `Content-Security-Policy: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox allow-modals; frame-ancestors 'self'`, so it runs in an opaque origin whether framed by the share page or opened on its own. Does not count as a view.

302.description: Redirect to a short-lived presigned URL

410.description: Link expired, revoked or used up

get.description: Serves (or redirects to a short-lived presigned URL for) the shared file with Content-Disposition: attachment. Does not count as a view.

302.description: Redirect to a short-lived presigned URL

410.description: Link expired, revoked or used up

get.summary: File of a shared folder (site share)
get.description: Serves a file from a folder shared with the share-create op (kind "site"). An empty path or one ending in '/' serves that folder's index.html. A folder without index.html redirects (302) to its only .html/.htm file, or else returns an HTML listing of its HTML pages (other files and sub-folders are never listed); a folder with no HTML page is 404. A folder named without its trailing slash redirects (301) to the slash form when that serves a page. `/site/{token}` redirects to `/site/{token}/`. The token is the only credential. Every response is proxied through this server (no presigned redirects) and carries `Content-Security-Policy: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox allow-modals; frame-ancestors *` (an opaque origin: no cookies or storage), `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Cache-Control: no-store` and `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`. Files over 25 MB are refused. Does not count views. `/site/*` has its own per-IP rate limit (`AGENT_FS_SITE_RATE_LIMIT`, default 600/min).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path inside the shared folder; may contain '/'. Empty for index.html.

200.description: File bytes, with the content type of the file name

301.description: Redirect to the folder form with a trailing slash

400.description: Path is not valid inside the folder ('.', '..', NUL, bad encoding)

404.description: Unknown token, not a site share, or no such file

429.description: Too many requests from this address

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR: email missing, or has no domain while AGENT_FS_REGISTER_ALLOWED_DOMAINS is set

403.description: REGISTRATION_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED: email domain is not in AGENT_FS_REGISTER_ALLOWED_DOMAINS

get.description: The one /auth route an org-scoped key (minted by an org admin) may call. For such a key the answer is identity only: `userId`, `email`, `displayName` and `scopedOrgId`, without the personal `defaultOrgId`/`defaultDriveId`. Every other key gets the defaults and `scopedOrgId: null`.

scopedOrgId.description: Org the calling key is limited to; null for an unscoped key

patch.description: Names are trimmed and limited to 1–100 characters. Send null to clear. No target user ID is accepted.

post.description: Rotates the caller's primary API key. The old key stops working immediately. Also revokes every org-scoped key of the caller (keys org admins minted); keys from POST /auth/keys keep working. Records an api_key_reset audit event.

patch.summary: Set the org's swarm URL (org admin only)
patch.description: Sets or clears the agent-swarm dashboard this org trusts for sign-in. The live UI shows a key-less visitor of an org deep link a "Continue with <swarm host>" action that opens <swarmUrl>/fs/continue. The value must be an absolute http or https URL without credentials, query or fragment; a trailing slash is dropped. Sending the stored value again is a no-op, so a swarm can set it on every boot. Members below admin get 403, non-members 404.

swarmUrl.description: http(s) URL, or null to clear

403.description: Caller is not an org admin

get.summary: Where to sign in to an org (no auth)
get.description: Public, for a browser with no key on an org deep link. Returns only the org's swarm URL. Unknown orgs get the same null as orgs without one, so the route reveals no org names and does not confirm that an org exists. Per-IP rate limit (120/min).

200.description: The org's swarm URL, or null

429.description: Too many requests from this address

post.summary: Reset a member's API key (org admin only)
post.description: For another member, mints a new API key scoped to this org (it reaches only /orgs/{orgId}/...) and revokes the member's other keys scoped to it; their primary key and their own unscoped keys keep working. For the caller's own userId, rotates the caller's primary key like POST /auth/reset-key. Org-scoped keys get 403 here. Records an api_key_reset audit event with the admin as actor.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: ID of the member whose key to reset

keyId.description: Id of the new org-scoped key (another member only)

orgId.description: Org the new key is limited to (another member only)

403.description: Caller is not an org admin

404.description: Org not found, or userId is not a member of the org

get.description: Lists the caller's active keys: the primary key (id `primary`, the one register and reset-key hand out) and every non-revoked additional key, including org-scoped keys an org admin minted for the caller. Never returns hashes or plaintext. `createdAt` and `lastUsedAt` are null for the primary key. `lastUsedAt` is refreshed at most once per minute per key. Org-scoped keys get 403 here.

orgId.description: Org the key is limited to; null for a key that reaches the whole account

createdByUserId.description: Who minted the key: the user, or the org admin who did

current.description: True for the key that authenticated this request

post.description: Mints a new key for the caller next to the existing ones; no other key changes. The key reaches the whole account, like the primary. The plaintext key is returned once and never stored. Records an api_key_created audit event in the caller's personal org. Org-scoped keys get 403 here.

delete.summary: Revoke one of your API keys
delete.description: Revokes the key immediately. Any key may be revoked, including `primary`, the key making the request, and the last remaining key. A user with no keys left is locked out until an org admin runs POST /orgs/{orgId}/members/{userId}/reset-key, which mints a new primary key. Records an api_key_revoked audit event in the caller's personal org.

404.description: No active key with this id belongs to the caller

post.summary: Create an additional API key for a member (org admin only)
post.description: Org admins can mint an extra key for a member of the org without touching the member's existing keys (reset-key, by contrast, rotates the primary key). The key is scoped to this org: it authenticates as the member only on /orgs/{orgId} and the routes under it, with the member's current role; every other path returns 403, and so does POST /orgs/{orgId}/members/{userId}/reset-key. It is revoked when the member leaves the org, when the minting admin leaves the org or loses admin there, and when the member runs their own POST /auth/reset-key. The plaintext key is returned once and never stored. Records an api_key_created audit event in this org with the admin as actor.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: ID of the member to mint a key for

orgId.description: The org the key is limited to

403.description: Caller is not an org admin

404.description: Org not found, or userId is not a member of the org

get.description: Any drive member can read the in-memory snapshot. Presence expires after 45 seconds without a PUT.

404.description: Drive not found or the user is not a member

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: presence request limit or 32 sessions per user per drive exceeded

put.description: Any drive member can insert or replace their session. Unknown body keys are stripped. Equal states refresh TTL without broadcasting.

404.description: Drive not found or the user is not a member

409.description: EDIT_CONFLICT: sessionId belongs to another user

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: presence request limit or 32 sessions per user per drive exceeded

delete.description: Only the owner can delete a session. An unknown session also succeeds.

404.description: Drive not found or the user is not a member

409.description: EDIT_CONFLICT: sessionId belongs to another user

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: presence request limit or 32 sessions per user per drive exceeded

get.description: Drive members can stream committed changes with Bearer authentication. The first event is ready. Heartbeat comments (: ping) arrive every 5 seconds. Each user can open at most 8 concurrent streams. Events are live only, with no replay.

parameters.name: presence
parameters.description: Opt in to presence frames. Without presence=1 no presence frames are sent.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: With presence=1, bind a valid sessionId. The last stream to close removes its session.

200.description: SSE frames use event: <name> and data: <JSON>, followed by a blank line.

presence.snapshot.description: Only sent when presence=1, immediately after ready.

404.description: Drive not found or the user is not a member

409.description: EDIT_CONFLICT: with presence=1, the sessionId belongs to another user

429.description: Concurrent stream cap or request rate limit exceeded

post.description: All file operations go through this single endpoint. The `op` field determines which operation to execute.

oneOf.title: write
oneOf.description: Write or overwrite a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, or creates a new version. Use expectedVersion for optimistic concurrency. Returns { version, path, size }.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: cat
oneOf.description: Read file content with optional pagination via offset/limit; defaults to the first 200 lines when limit is omitted. Returns { content, totalLines, truncated } — always check `truncated` before trusting a row/line count. For a complete, byte-exact read (e.g. before parsing as CSV/JSON), use `download` instead.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: edit
oneOf.description: Replace a specific string in a file (surgical find-and-replace). Captures the edit intent as a diff summary in version history. Returns { version, path, changes }.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: append
oneOf.description: Append content to the end of an existing file. Creates a new version. Returns { version, size }.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: ls
oneOf.description: List immediate children of a directory. Returns { entries } where each entry has name, type (file/directory), size, author, modifiedAt.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: stat
oneOf.description: Get file metadata without reading content. Returns path, size, contentType, author, currentVersion, createdAt, modifiedAt, isDeleted, embeddingStatus, etag (opaque id of the current bytes, compare for equality). Embedding status is pending, indexed, failed, or skipped.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: reveal
oneOf.description: Everything needed to show one file in a tree, in one call: the ls listing of every ancestor directory (root first) plus the file's stat. Returns { path, stat, listings } where each listing is { path, entries } with entries shaped exactly like ls.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: rm
oneOf.description: Delete a file. Removes from S3, cleans up FTS5 index and vector embeddings. Returns { path, deleted }.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: mv
oneOf.description: Move or rename a file. Preserves version history at the new path. Returns { from, to, version }.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: cp
oneOf.description: Copy a file using server-side S3 copy. Creates a new version at the destination. Returns { from, to, version }.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: tail
oneOf.description: Read the last N lines of a file (default 20). Returns { content, totalLines, truncated }.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: log
oneOf.description: Show version history for a file. Returns { versions } with version number, author, timestamp, operation type, message, and diff summary.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: diff
oneOf.description: Show the diff between two versions of a file. Specify v1 and v2 version numbers. Returns { changes, source } as add/remove/context hunks; when file content was diffed each change carries oldLine/newLine. source is 'content' when both versions were compared, 'summary' when changes come from the stored edit summary, or 'none' when the versions were not compared at all. Only source 'content' with empty changes means the versions are identical.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: revert
oneOf.description: Revert a file to a previous version. Creates a new version with the old content. Returns { version, revertedTo }.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: recent
oneOf.description: Show recent activity across the drive. Optionally filter by path prefix and time window (since). Returns { entries } with path and version details.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: grep
oneOf.description: Search file content using regex pattern within a specific path. Returns matching lines with line numbers. Searches the FTS5 index, not S3 directly.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: fts
oneOf.description: Full-text search across all file content using FTS5 tokens. Different from grep (regex) and search (semantic). Returns { matches } with path, snippet, and rank.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: search
oneOf.description: Hybrid search combining semantic (vector) and keyword (FTS5) matching. Best for natural language queries. Degrades to keyword-only without an embedding provider.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: vec-search
oneOf.description: Vector-only semantic search using embeddings. Returns results ranked by cosine similarity. Requires an embedding provider (OPENAI_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, or local).

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: reindex
oneOf.description: Re-index files with failed or missing FTS5/embedding entries. Skip files with indexed or skipped status. Optionally scope to a path prefix. Use after bulk writes or provider changes.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: tree
oneOf.description: Recursively list all files and directories. Use depth to limit recursion. Returns a nested tree structure with name, type, size, and children.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: glob
oneOf.description: Find files by name pattern. Use `*.md` for root-level files only, `**/*.md` for recursive matching across all subdirectories. Supports `*` (any chars except /), `?` (single char), `**` (any path depth). Optionally scope to a path prefix. Case-sensitive. To look up a file by an approximate name, use find. Returns { matches } with path, size, and modifiedAt.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: find
oneOf.description: Find files by approximate name. Matching is case- and accent-insensitive. Every query word must match the path, in any order. When no file has every word as typed, letters can be skipped ("zphr" finds "Zephyr.pdf"). File-name hits rank above folder hits. Optionally scope to a path prefix. Returns { matches, total }: matches holds path, size, modifiedAt, and score, best first, capped at limit (default 50). total counts all matching files.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: sql
oneOf.description: Run a DuckDB SQL query over documents stored in the drive. Reference documents directly by path string literal (e.g. SELECT * FROM '/data/sales.csv') or bind them as named tables via `tables` ({ name: path } or { name: { path, format } } to override format detection). Supports csv, tsv, parquet, xlsx, json, ndjson/jsonl (each also .gz except parquet/xlsx), sqlite (.db/.sqlite/.sqlite3, tables exposed as name.tablename), and .duckdb files. Queries run sandboxed: no filesystem or network access beyond the bound documents. Returns { columns, rows, rowCount, truncated, files, elapsedMs }.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: signed-url
oneOf.description: Generate a temporary presigned URL for direct file download. Default expiry is 24 hours (86400 seconds). The URL requires no authentication. Set disposition to "inline" when the URL will be rendered in the browser (PDF in an iframe, image in a tab); the default "attachment" forces a download. Returns { url, path, expiresIn, expiresAt, kind }.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: share-create
oneOf.description: Create a public share link for a file or folder. A file gets an unauthenticated /share/<token> page on the API host with a preview (markdown, text/code, image, PDF, audio, video, and HTML pages rendered in a sandboxed frame with only that file shared) and a Download button. A folder becomes an HTML site (kind "site") at /site/<token>/: index.html is the entry page (without one, the only HTML page opens, or else a list of the HTML pages), relative paths resolve inside the folder, and pages run in a sandbox with no cookies or localStorage. A site page can read every file under its folder while the link is valid. Default expiry is 24 hours (max 7 days); expiresIn null makes a link with no time limit, which ends only with share-revoke or at maxViews. Set maxViews to limit how often a file page can be opened (maxViews=1 is a one-off link; folders reject maxViews). Anyone with the link can open it, so share deliberately. Returns { id, kind, url, urlSource, sharePath, path, expiresIn, expiresAt, maxViews } (expiresIn and expiresAt are null for a link that never expires); urlSource (always present) is "configured" when url is built on AGENT_FS_PUBLIC_URL, "request" when it comes from the request's Host (resolve sharePath against the address you reached the API at). The link is shown only once; keep the id to revoke it.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: share-revoke
oneOf.description: Revoke share links so they stop working immediately. Pass exactly one of: id (from share-create), token (the token or the full share URL), or path (revokes every link to that file or folder). Only the link's creator or a drive admin can revoke. Returns { revoked, ids }.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: comment-add
oneOf.description: Add a comment to a file. Supports line ranges, a text-quote anchor ({ exact, prefix, suffix }), mentions by drive-member user ID or email, and threading via parentId. Replies auto-resolve path from parent. Returns { id, path, body, author, createdAt }.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

quote.description: Text-quote anchor: the exact selected text plus ~32 chars of context before (prefix) and after (suffix). Lets viewers re-find the selection after the file is edited.

oneOf.title: comment-list
oneOf.description: List comments on a file or below a path prefix. Filter by path, pathPrefix, resolved state, or parentId. Defaults to unresolved root comments. Returns { comments } with inline replies.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: comment-get
oneOf.description: Get a single comment by ID with all its replies. Returns { comment, replies }.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: comment-update
oneOf.description: Update a comment's body and optionally replace its mentions. Mentions accept drive-member user IDs or emails. Only the original author can update. Returns { id, body, updatedAt }.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: comment-delete
oneOf.description: Soft-delete a comment. Only the original author can delete. Deleting a root comment also soft-deletes its replies. Returns { deleted }.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: comment-resolve
oneOf.description: Resolve or reopen a root comment. Set resolved=true to resolve, resolved=false to reopen. Only root comments can be resolved. Returns { id, resolved, resolvedBy, resolvedAt }.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: comment-notification-list
oneOf.description: List comment or mention notifications for the current user in the active drive. Defaults to comment notifications. Returns { notifications, unreadCount }.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: comment-notification-read
oneOf.description: Mark selected comment or mention notification IDs, or all notifications of the selected kinds in the active drive, as read. All defaults to comment notifications. Returns { markedRead }.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: drive-members
oneOf.description: List members of the active drive. Returns { members } with userId, email, and displayName. Membership roles are not included.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: favorite-add
oneOf.description: Star a file or folder for the current user. Favorites are personal: no other user sees them. Starring twice is a no-op. Moving or renaming a starred file keeps the star; deleting it removes the star, and a folder's star goes away once the folder is gone. Returns { path, kind, createdAt, favorited }.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: favorite-remove
oneOf.description: Remove the current user's star from a file or folder. Works even when the path no longer exists. Returns { path, removed } where removed is false when there was no star.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: favorite-list
oneOf.description: List the current user's favorites in the active drive, sorted by path. Returns { favorites } with path, kind (file/directory), and createdAt.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: webhook-create
oneOf.description: Create an outbound webhook that POSTs signed Standard Webhooks events (comment.created, comment.mentioned, comment.updated, comment.resolved, comment.reopened, comment.deleted, file.changed) to url. Only the listed eventTypes are sent; file.changed (one per new file version: path, version, operation, author, size, etag, never content) must be listed explicitly, and pathPrefix limits it to one directory. scope 'drive' (default) covers the active drive and needs drive admin or org admin; scope 'org' covers every drive in the org and needs org admin. The url must be public https (private/loopback targets only via the server's AGENT_FS_WEBHOOK_ALLOWED_HOSTS). Returns the webhook plus its whsec_ signing secret, shown only this once. Delivery needs AGENT_FS_WEBHOOK_WORKER on the server (see workerEnabled).

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

scope.description: drive (default): the active drive only. org: every drive in the org (org admin only).

pathPrefix.description: Send file.changed only for paths under this directory, e.g. /docs/ (it does not filter comment events). Omit or '/' for every path.

oneOf.title: webhook-list
oneOf.description: List outbound webhooks. scope 'drive' needs drive admin or org admin, 'org' needs org admin, and 'all' (default) returns this drive's hooks for a drive admin plus the org's hooks for an org admin. Never returns signing secrets. Returns { webhooks }.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: webhook-update
oneOf.description: Update a webhook's url, eventTypes, description or pathPrefix, enable or disable it, or rotate its signing secret. Needs drive admin or org admin for a drive hook, org admin for an org hook. enabled=true clears the disabled state and failure counters; enabled=false fails its pending deliveries. rotateSecret=true returns the new whsec_ secret once; the old secret stops working at once (no grace period). Returns the webhook.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

pathPrefix.description: Directory that limits file.changed, e.g. /docs/. An empty string or '/' clears it.

oneOf.title: webhook-delete
oneOf.description: Delete a webhook and its delivery history. Needs drive admin or org admin for a drive hook, org admin for an org hook. Returns { deleted }.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: webhook-test
oneOf.description: Send a signed ping event to a webhook now, inline, and report the receiver's answer. Works with the delivery worker off and does not count toward failures. Needs drive admin or org admin for a drive hook, org admin for an org hook. Returns { ok, statusCode, error, durationMs, webhookId }.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: share-list
oneOf.description: List share links without revealing them: the link itself is shown only once, by share-create, and is never listed. scope "drive" (default) lists links in the active drive; drive admins see every member's links, everyone else only their own. With path, it returns the links on that file or folder plus folder (site) links on any parent folder that also publish it (relation "exact" or "covering"). scope "mine" lists your own links in every drive of this org you are a member of (one org, never across orgs; path not allowed). Active links only unless includeInactive is true. Newest first; limit (default 100, max 500) and offset page through total. Returns { shares, total, limit, offset, scope, visibility } where each share has id, drive { id, name }, path, kind (file/site), relation, status (active/expired/exhausted/revoked), createdAt, createdBy { userId, email, displayName }, expiresAt (null = never expires), views, maxViews, lastViewedAt, revokedAt, revokedBy { userId, email, displayName } (null when active or revoked before revokers were recorded), canRevoke, and appUrl when configured. Revoke a link with share-revoke and its id, on the drive in drive.id.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: webhook-deliveries
oneOf.description: List a webhook's delivery log, newest first: status (pending, delivered, failed), attempts, next attempt, last status code and error. Omits each delivery's payload unless includePayload is true (it is then the exact JSON body that was signed and sent). Delivered and failed rows are pruned after 30 days. Needs drive admin or org admin for a drive hook, org admin for an org hook. Returns { deliveries, nextCursor }; pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page (null on the last page).

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

oneOf.title: webhook-redeliver
oneOf.description: Queue one delivery to be sent again now with the same webhook-id and body: sets it pending, due now, and keeps its attempt count (a row past the retry schedule gets this one attempt, no further retries). Refused while the webhook is disabled (re-enable it with webhook-update enabled=true first) and while the delivery is being sent. Needs the same role as the webhook. Sent by the delivery worker (AGENT_FS_WEBHOOK_WORKER). Returns the delivery.

driveId.description: Target drive ID (optional, uses default drive)

schema.description: Response shape depends on the operation. See each op's description for details.
